entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the concepts and principles of literature
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate a broad understanding of the concepts of literature
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explain the aspects of society, artist, imagination, and literary language
teaching_learning_activities: Observation: Guide students in manageable groups through identifying common things found in the selected texts
Questions and answers: Guide students through using the knowledge gained from the texts to explain the concepts of society, artist, imagination, and literary language
Discussion: Guide students in manageable groups through discussing the concepts of society, artist, imagination, and literary language
entries.assessment: The aspects of society, artist, imagination, specialized language are broadly explained
resources: Selected literary texts
folklore materials
pictures and audio/ audio-visual materials
entries.references: TIE, Literature in English for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
